concern_results.conclusion: Independently traced both trust paths against the diff. Classification input is restricted to top-level error/*.failed events (kind == "error" or endswith(".failed"), message or error.message), so the nested item.completed fixtures carrying 429/quota vocabulary cannot steer the verdict; model text likewise has no path into transport_diagnostic, which is built only from that extracted file — raw stderr never enters the builder. Walked every fixture shape through the redactor by hand: home spellings (literal, trailing-slash, realpath, longest-first), sk-, Bearer, eyJ, compound a=1&b=2, semicolon/comma-separated, single- and double-quoted assignments, and {"k": "v"} pairs are all consumed; userinfo strips greedily to the last @ before the path boundary so the p@ss...value@ password tail cannot survive; the query strip is guarded by a deliberately non-assignment-shaped fixture secret so the assignment rule cannot mask its deletion. Bound is 585+12=597 chars after whitespace collapse (single line guaranteed), truncation keeps the head; placeholder is reachable only in the run_rc!=0 branch when the builder emits nothing, cannot mask a non-empty extraction, and the success path is byte-identical with neither new key (tested). emit_inconclusive's added positionals default empty so every pre-existing call site, reason code, cascade flag and exit code is unchanged; the only stderr classification delta is the added 'usage limit' alternative, which is the intended fix. Residual escapes I constructed (escaped-quote JSON values, scheme-less URL queries, realpath-spelled run-root on symlinked TMPDIR) are either explicitly stated accepted residuals over transport-authored-only input, neutralized by json.dumps control-character escaping, or disclose nothing beyond the physical run-dir path the receipt already commits by design — none material.

The steered-verdict bypass (packet → classifier → review_gate.py cascade vs stop_reviewer_lane) is contained at the extraction boundary and the containment is executed, not asserted: quota_in_model_output yields unknown_client_failure/cascade false, and the four single-predicate mutations each red exactly their predicted rows, including removal of the top-level restriction. The egress crossing (CLI output → committed receipt) is bounded at 600 chars, one line, deduplicated, redacted at build time, with the primary control being removal of arbitrary stderr from the receipt rather than filter completeness; the preserved run directory is mode 0700 under TMPDIR holding only what the in-flight run held, home-elided by physical-path comparison on both sides (trailing-slash case tested). CANDIDATE_LOCAL_CODES, existing reason codes and exit codes are untouched; Bash 3.2 parse hazard was avoided by file-write instead of heredoc-in-substitution. No high-risk bypass found.
